# Problem 1
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
nyc_transit = read_csv("data/NYC_Transit_Subway_Entrance_And_Exit_Data.csv")
nyc_transit = janitor::clean_names(nyc_transit)
nyc_transit = select(nyc_transit,line, division, station_name, station_latitude, station_longitude, route1:route11, entry, vending, entrance_type, ada)

nyc_transit = mutate(nyc_transit, entry = case_match(entry, "YES" ~ TRUE,"NO"~ FALSE))
```
This NYC transit dataset contains information on subway line, station name, station latitude / longitude, routes served, entry, vending, entrance type, and ADA compliance. The dataset was cleaned using janitor::clean_names(), and the specific variables were chosen using select(), and mutate and case_match were used to convert the entry variable from yes/no to true/false. Overall, the dataset has 1868 rows and 20 columns, but routes are spread across multiple columns so the data is not tidy. 

```{r}
#distinct stations
nrow(distinct(nyc_transit, line, station_name))
#ADA compliant stations
nrow(distinct(filter(nyc_transit, ada == TRUE), line, station_name))
#Proportion of station entrances/exits without vending allow entrance?
no_vending = filter(nyc_transit, vending == "NO")
mean(no_vending$entry, na.rm = TRUE)
```
The dataset has 465 distinct subway stations, and they are identified by both name and by line. 
84 stations are ADA compliant.
0.38 of station entrances / exits without vending allow entrance.

```{r}
# Reformat route data
nyc_transit_long = nyc_transit |>
mutate(across(route1:route11, as.character)) |>
pivot_longer(route1:route11, names_to = "route_number", values_to = "route_name")

# Stations serving A train
nrow(distinct(filter(nyc_transit_long, route_name == "A"), line, station_name))
# ADA compliant stations serving A train
nrow(distinct(filter(nyc_transit_long, route_name == "A" & ada == TRUE), line, station_name))

```
There are 60 distinct stations serving the A train, of which 17 are ADA compliant.

#Problem 2
```{r}
library(readxl)

# Mr. Trash Wheel dataset
trash_wheel = read_excel("data/202610 Trash Wheel Collection Data.xlsx",
sheet = "Mr. Trash Wheel",
range = "A2:N742")
trash_wheel = janitor::clean_names(trash_wheel)

# round number of sports balls
trash_wheel = trash_wheel |>
mutate(sports_balls = as.integer(round(sports_balls)))
head(trash_wheel)

# Professor Trash Wheel dataset
professor_trash_wheel = read_excel("data/202610 Trash Wheel Collection Data.xlsx",
sheet = "Professor Trash Wheel",
range = "A2:M139") |>
janitor::clean_names() |>
mutate(trash_wheel = "Professor Trash Wheel")
head(professor_trash_wheel)

# Gwynnda dataset
gwynnda_trash_wheel = read_excel("data/202610 Trash Wheel Collection Data.xlsx",
sheet = "Gwynnda the Good Wheel of the W",
range = "A2:L394") |>
janitor::clean_names() |>
mutate(trash_wheel = "Gwynnda")
head(gwynnda_trash_wheel)

# Combine datasets
# Make 'year' and 'plastic_bottles' variable same type across datasets
trash_wheel = trash_wheel |>
mutate(year = as.character(year),
plastic_bottles = as.character(plastic_bottles))

professor_trash_wheel = professor_trash_wheel |>
mutate(year = as.character(year),
plastic_bottles = as.character(plastic_bottles))

gwynnda_trash_wheel = gwynnda_trash_wheel |>
mutate(year = as.character(year),
plastic_bottles = as.character(plastic_bottles))

# Combine
trash_wheel_combined = bind_rows(trash_wheel, professor_trash_wheel, gwynnda_trash_wheel)

head(trash_wheel_combined)

# Observations
nrow(trash_wheel_combined)

# total weight of trash collected by Professor Trash Wheel
professor_trash_wheel |>
filter(trash_wheel == "Professor Trash Wheel") |>
summarize(total_weight = sum(weight_tons, na.rm = TRUE))

# number of cigarette butts collected by Gwynnda in June of 2022
gwynnda_trash_wheel |>
filter(month == "June", year == "2022") |>
summarize(total_cigarette_butts = sum(cigarette_butts, na.rm = TRUE))

```
There are `r nrow(trash_wheel_combined)` observations in the combined dataset, including variables for dumpster number, month, year, date, trash weight (tons) and volume (cubic yards), plastic bottles, polystyrene, cigarette butts, glass bottles, plastic bags, wrappers, sports balls, and homes powered. The total weight of trash collected by Professor Trash Wheel was `r sum(professor_trash_wheel$weight_tons, na.rm = TRUE)` tons. The total number of cigarette butts collected by Gwynnda in June of 2022 was `r sum(gwynnda_trash_wheel$cigarette_butts[gwynnda_trash_wheel$month == "June" & gwynnda_trash_wheel$year == "2022"], na.rm = TRUE)`.
